findings.rule: A null-comparing Unity cache triggers FindObjectOfType<DialogueSystemController>. Runtime initializer clears cache. Own-assembly field-use scan finds stores only in getter/initializer; controller Awake does not set this manager cache. findings.locator: FindPrepare.cs; prepare-definitions.json; logger-prepare.il; events-methods.il; wrapper-controller-methods.il; wrapper-events-methods.il
findings.rule: Exact OnPrepareConversationLine method-name scan across all150 individually pinned original DLLs finds only ConversationLogger.OnPrepareConversationLine(DialogueEntry). It returns for null, otherwise reads currentDialogueText, formats and logs; no entry stores/setters or event forwards in this body. Existing phase79 getter/selector evidence remains unchanged. Events and wrappers do not declare a prepare method. Later loaded/native/generated code and actual Unity dispatch remain unaccepted.

The202308-object existing inventory has one Wrappers.DialogueSystemController candidate sharedassets0.assets:4608 on GameObject1297 named DialogueManager, and one events component4612. Direct original readback verifies all six component raw bytes, candidate/export value parity with corrected MonoBehaviour headers, initialDatabase=3336, instantiateDatabase=false, allowOnlyOneInstance=true, dontDestroyOnLoad=false. Neither Logger nor SceneEvents is attached. Inventory has no such class instances. Instantiation/active scene/selected manager/transient objects are not proven.

findings.locator: entry-scene-guid.il get_sceneEventGuid IL_0000..0010; set_sceneEventGuid IL_0000..000c; field-lookup-value.il; prior field-selectors.il/field-predicate.il
findings.rule: Getter uses exact EventGuid, first case-sensitive LookupValue. Missing field returns null, not empty; an existing field returns its value unchanged including null/empty/whitespace. Setter uses SetTextField(EventGuid,value). All126 registrations/114 unique target entries lack EventGuid in both exact copies. This replaces the earlier scene/event-name heuristic, not the frozen source.

Separate sceneInstance cache uses FindObjectOfType<DialogueSystemSceneEvents> on a null-comparing Unity object; Awake sets itself, public setter can replace it, runtime initializer clears. Lookup returns null when no scene object. Otherwise List.Find returns first event whose guid == supplied guid. No null/empty GUID guard. Synthetic null-guid and empty-guid positives plus distinct null-versus-empty negative prove the supplied Python transcription, not runtime scene identity/list content. Null source GUID alone cannot eliminate invocation.

skipExecution=true skips entry userScript/onExecute and scene lookup/invoke but not prepare, displayed mark, Lua setup or actor/conversant resolution. With skipExecution=false, after actor/conversant info, resolve scene event with conditional current sceneEventGuid. Compute argument from valid speaker transform GameObject or manager GameObject fallback. If event nonnull invoke its GameObjectUnityEvent before subtitleText and Parse. Empty persistent entry onExecute does not remove the independent scene path; actual cached scene/listeners/invocation/mutation are unaccepted.
